name: Performance Food Group
outlook:
What Performance Food Group says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: net sales and adjusted EBITDAFor the second quarter of fiscal 2027, PFG expects net sales to be in a range of approximately $17.0 billion to $17.2 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $490 million to $510 million.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: net sales and adjusted EBITDAFor the full fiscal year 2027, PFG continues to expect net sales to be in a range of approximately $72.5 billion to $73.0 billion and Adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of approximately $2.125 billion to $2.225 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
